system: You are an ambitious AI researcher who is looking to publish a paper that will contribute significantly to the field.
task_description: You are given a structured healthcare benchmark built from the MIT-BIH Arrhythmia feature table on Hugging Face. Each sample contains 34 ECG-derived interval and morphology features and a class label describing the arrhythmia type. The features are naturally grouped into two lead-specific blocks (0_* and 1_*), which creates an opportunity for lead-aware fusion and imbalance-aware training. Your task is to improve macro-F1, balanced accuracy, and calibration while keeping the model lightweight and interpretable.
